title: Film Reel Collision
description: A dramatic cinematic scene inside a crumbling, ornate room where a woman in a flowing emerald green dress and a man wearing a skull mask and dark coat stand locked together. A glowing film strip is wrapped tightly around their waists emitting sparks and light as movie equipment, clapperboards, and film reels lie scattered across the paint-splattered floor.
prompt: A surreal cinematic painting of a beautiful woman in a flowing emerald green dress dancing with a tall man wearing a white skull mask and dark trench coat. A glowing film strip is wrapped around their bodies emitting sparks and light beams. They stand in a decaying ornate hall with cracked walls and falling picture frames. Movie clapperboards, film reels and equipment are scattered on the paint-splattered floor. Dramatic god rays shine from above, dynamic composition, painterly style.
